title: Parsons' past-life regression as Simon the Sorcerer
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Parsons' past-life regression as Simon the Sorcerer, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but his his past life regression was Simon the Sorcerer

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jack Parsons, an early American rocket scientist, underwent a past-life regression, a practice where someone is guided to "remember" lives they supposedly lived before. According to Michels, Parsons came to believe he had once been Simon the Sorcerer, a magician figure from early Christian times. He tells it to show the mystical side of a man tied to early rocketry.
